About the MOB

1K MOB MANAGEMENT is a record label & creative direction company based in Denver, Colorado. Launched in October 2026, the company was built to move independent artists like a major — real management, real rollouts, real business.

Home to recording artist Gudda 1K, the MOB handles everything around the music: booking the shows, working the press, placing the features, and directing the look and story of every release — including Gudda 1K’s single “Not A Player,” out now on all platforms.

Denver first. Everywhere next.
